KIIRA chibi character model

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/chibi-3dm-collection-textured-rigged-redone
Author: Chad Wolfe (Chloe Wolfe)
License: CC-BY-SA 3.0 (also listed: CC-BY 3.0, GPL 3.0, GPL 2.0, OGA-BY 3.0)

Used as the low-poly Q-style mesh ("skin") for the 3D-to-2D pixel base
pipeline. The model's own armature and demo texture are discarded; the
separate part meshes (HEAD / TORSO / ARMS / HANDS / LEGS / FEET) are
split, re-scaled to Q proportions, and bound to the project's
GuideRigG1 armature (the verified G1 walk skeleton).

Attribution: KIIRA by Chad Wolfe, CC-BY-SA 3.0.
